note: What a server sends to put the match on hold. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: seat
fields.note: The seat that called the hold.

fields.name: timeLeft
fields.note: How long the hold can run, in seconds.

bits.name: unlimited
bits.note: Set where the hold is not counted against a limit.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined; a server sends it clear.
